verdict.rationale: Evidence only indirectly implies a self-hosted option exists (Bitbucket Server/Data Center) via migration-to-cloud messaging (bitbucket-docs-15, bitbucket-docs-16), rather than any direct documentation of self-hosting the core product's AI-native capabilities. Missing for 10: explicit self-host installation/deployment docs, confirmation that AI features (Rovo, AI code reviewer) work in self-hosted Data Center, and independent corroboration of self-hosting viability.
